text: Good morning Rohan. Welcome to Elyx. We'll start with onboarding this week. Could you share your key health priorities and current routine?

Thanks Ruby. My main priorities are reducing cardiovascular risk, keeping cholesterol and BP under control, and improving focus at work. I currently exercise about 3 days a week and follow a mostly vegetarian diet.
Got it. We'll tailor your program accordingly. Do you have any ongoing medical conditions or medications we should know about?
I have borderline high BP but I'm not on medication. No other conditions. Family history of heart disease though.
Thanks Rohan, that context is important. We'll run a baseline cardiovascular risk screen, including ApoB, Lp(a), hs-CRP, OGTT, and a lipid panel. This helps us set benchmarks.
We've scheduled your blood tests and diagnostic scans for April 5 at 09:00. Please fast for 12 hours beforehand.
Understood. Should I avoid coffee that morning?
Yes, avoid coffee and tea. Water is fine.
Heading for the blood panel now. Recovery this morning was 38%.
Great. After the lab visit, our team physician will also do a quick physical exam. Results will be available in 48 hours.
Rohan, your baseline blood panel is back. ApoB and Lp(a) are mildly elevated, BP is borderline, and hs-CRP is within range. We'll keep a close watch. No urgent concerns.
Thanks for the update. What does this mean for my plan?
It means we'll emphasize lipid management and BP control early on. We'll combine dietary adjustments with lifestyle support. Nothing drastic yet.
Can you share what your typical daily meals look like? That will help us refine the nutrition plan.
Breakfast is usually oats or toast, lunch is Indian vegetarian food with rice and dal, dinner is lighter like soup or salad. I do snack on biscuits in the evenings. Recovery was 42% this morning.
Thanks. We'll suggest swaps for snacks and add protein sources. We'll also align with the cardiometabolic risk profile.
How many hours of sleep are you averaging per night?
Around 6 hours on weekdays, a bit more on weekends. Recovery 45%.
We'll aim for 7-7.5 hours as a target. Sleep is critical for recovery and BP regulation. We'll build sleep hygiene practices into your plan.
Let's talk about stress management. Do you currently do meditation or breathing exercises?
Not regularly. I've tried meditation apps but I don't stick with them. Recovery this morning was 39%.
We'll start with 5-minute daily guided breathing. This is manageable and builds consistency.
We've compiled all baseline data. Your starter plan (v1.0) will focus on diet clean-up, sleep hygiene, stress baseline, and light strength workouts. We'll launch it in May.
Sounds good. Looking forward to starting. Recovery 47% today.
Great. This month was about building your health profile. May will be about applying the first plan.
